name: Subhadeep Datta
title: Full Stack Engineer & CTO
shortBio: Full Stack Engineer & CTO specializing in distributed systems, high-performance APIs, and AI integrations. I currently lead engineering at Hirerkey and Noisiv Consulting, building software that powers millions of interactions.
longBio: I'm a Full Stack Engineer and CTO who loves solving hard scaling problems. Currently, I'm the Co-Founder & CTO at Hirerkey, building an AI-native HR platform in Dubai, and the Consulting CTO at Noisiv Consulting, where I design backend systems that handle millions of daily API requests. Before this, I led the technical team at Qid, scaling India's top digital ID gateway to handle massive daily traffic spikes. I write code primarily in Java, Node.js, and Python, and I rely heavily on Kafka, Redis, and MongoDB to keep systems fast and reliable.

projects.title: Hirerkey — Workplace Intelligence Platform
projects.description: Built the core architecture for a modern AI-based Human Capital Management platform. Designed the infrastructure using Java and Node.js, and integrated RAG pipelines to automate complex HR workflows.

projects.title: Noisiv Consulting
projects.description: Architected backend infrastructure for enterprise clients that processes millions of requests a day. Focused heavily on database schema optimization and implementing robust message queues to drop latency and guarantee 99.9% uptime.

projects.title: Qid — India's #1 ID Gateway
projects.description: Led the engineering team to build a secure digital check-in gateway processing 100,000+ verifications. The biggest challenge was ensuring real-time data sync in low-bandwidth environments, which we solved using an offline-first architecture and aggressive Redis caching.

projects.title: Videtorrium
projects.description: Helped build the early versions of Videtorrium, a hiring platform focused on matching students with high-paying opportunities. Worked across the stack with React and Node.js to ship features fast.

experience.summary: Leading technical strategy and product engineering. Architected the main platform with Java, Node.js, MongoDB, and Kafka. Integrated LLMs and RAG models to automate HR processes, directly contributing to our $2.5M valuation.

Designing systems that handle millions of daily API requests. Reduced database response times by 60% through schema optimization and implemented Kafka/Redis queues processing 75,000+ messages per second.
Managed a team of 5 engineers to build a digital check-in platform. Integrated with India Stack APIs for identity verification and set up Redis caching layers that reduced our database load by 40%.
Built core product features using React and Node.js. Mentored junior developers and helped establish our early engineering practices.
